chunks: Even if they are patient, their abode is Hell; and if they beg for favour, none will favour them.
ai.seo_question: What happens to disbelievers if they are patient or seek intercession in the Hereafter?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the futility of the disbelievers' choice between steadfastness in error and seeking intercession, as neither leads to salvation. It underscores the concept of 'istitab' (seeking favor/intercession) being ineffective for those whose hearts are sealed, reinforcing the finality of divine decree for the disbelievers.
